data: Reuse the exact stage1 audited2014-10-31 to2026-11-04 datasets and all314 raw receipts. Seal every stage1 artifact before writing stage2 evidence. No new market outcomes requested.

independent_event_rule: At first eligible clustered C95 event reserve a fixed70-instrument-session cooldown regardless of which entry/exit succeeds. Shared event IDs across all candidates; max5 entry-wait+60 holding+1 fill <70. No future-dependent event selection.
entry_details: Full=10% NAV at next actual open. Down variant50% immediately then50% after close<=first open*.95, within10 sessions. No third tranche; exit/trim before add; no reset of first-entry clock.
exit_details: All completed-close decisions fill at following actual open. Profit/stop relative to cumulative cost including fees and realized partial proceeds. Trail10 from highest observed close. Time-stop exits after10 held sessions if net liquidation PnL<=0; otherwise max40. Risk exits net loss>=10% OR existing00631L regimeBEAR and close<MA10; max40. Fixed horizons exit at entry_index+H. Never fill at the high/low or a guaranteed stop price.
exposure_control: All candidates and constant-weight controls share10% at purchase; a close over10% schedules an excess-only reduction at next open, after exiting first if needed. Gap/intraday breaches cannot be guaranteed away; report count and maximum. No new BUY on a trim day.
units: Fractional split-adjusted research units, NOT executable broker lots. Historical price limits/queues, minimum fees and capacity not certified.
time_validation: 2014-2017 feature training;2018 onward annual past-only thresholds with fixed rules, NO full-period winner selection. Report2018-2021,2022-2024,2025-2026 plus individual years. ALL periods already inspected by stage1, never call new untouched OOS. No new model selection optimization.
statistics: Per model closed-trade median/CI plus shared-event outcome including zero allocation when no confirmation. A fixed70-session episode is the event cluster, not a claim of independence across regimes. Year-block2000-bootstrap mean/median intervals. Paired entry effects vsNEXT_OPEN per exit, exact year-block sign-flip p and Holm adjustment across27 entry contrasts; also9 exit contrasts vsTIME20 per entry (32 non-reference exit contrasts), separate declared family. benchmarks: 00631L and0050 B&H100% and10% initial allocation (context with exposure drift). Also daily10% constant-weight next-open risk-budget controls, same friction/yield; not mislabeled B&H. Compare actual capital utilization and calendar flat time, not returns alone.
opportunity_validation: Use common C95 event outcomes; pre-event velocity percentile and20-session close drawdown from prior training, report conditional bins and Spearman association only. No fit of weights or0-100 score. A90 descriptive event-screen robustness only, not another36-model search.
